title:
More Valheim.
Less admin.
sub:
Your worlds. Your mods.
Your whole party, in sync.
caption: PhValheim manages your Valheim worlds, mods and shared setup in one place.

title:
One container.
Your world.
sub:
Start with Docker. Use the setup wizard.
Create a vanilla or modded world.
caption: Start PhValheim with Docker, complete the setup wizard, then create a vanilla or modded world.

title:
Your server.
At a glance.
sub:
Start, stop and update your worlds.
Keep each world's setup separate.
caption: Manage multiple worlds from your browser: start, stop, update, settings and logs.

title:
Find it.
Enable it.
sub:
Thunderstore. Hexium. Your local mods.
Search, select, pin a version—or follow latest.
caption: Select mods from Thunderstore, Hexium or Hugin's Vibes. Pin versions or follow the latest.

title:
Tune the rules.
Keep the settings.
sub:
Edit mod configs in your browser.
Saved overrides survive world updates.
caption: Edit mod settings in the browser. Saved overrides are reapplied when the world starts or updates.

title:
Your choices.
One shared pack.
sub:
Update the world to build its mod payload.
Dependencies and shared configs come along.
caption: Update the world to resolve dependencies and package mods plus shared configurations for players. Server-only configs stay private.

title:
Pick a world.
Sync. Launch.
sub:
The PhValheim client downloads changes
before launching your modded game.
caption: Choose a world on your host’s website. The PhValheim client syncs changed mods and configs before launch. Vanilla worlds use ordinary Valheim.

title:
Back it up.
Stay in control.
sub:
Backups, restores, player access and logs.
The everyday jobs, in one place.
caption: Manage world backups and restores, control player access, and inspect logs from the admin interface.

title:
Need a hand?
Ask Hugin.
sub:
Investigate server problems.
Review proposed changes before applying.
caption: Ask Hugin to investigate problems and propose changes. Review before applying. AI features are optional.

title:
Have a mod idea?
Vibe it.
sub:
Hugin's Vibes writes, builds and packages.
The Build Pak prepares the tools and libraries.
caption: Hugin's Vibes helps write, build and package mods. The optional Build Pak prepares tools and local game references.

title:
Your own mod.
Your catalogue.
sub:
Publish locally. Select it on a test world.
Update, sync, play—and keep improving.
caption: Publish to your local catalogue. Select the mod on a test world, update and sync. Each Vibe has local Git history.

title:
You bring
the adventure.
sub:
PhValheim handles the setup.
Host. Mod. Sync. Play.
caption: Host. Mod. Sync. Play. Get started at brianmiller.github.io/phvalheim-server.
